arrangement: A spacious graphic poster has a narrow title band above a large geometric image and a small caption below.

regions.depiction: The word SHIFT appears in large dark geometric lettering on a warm cream ground.
Three flat blue discs overlap along an upward diagonal. A small orange square sits above the last disc.
The words A STUDY IN MOTION appear in small dark lettering with generous spacing.

relationships.relation: The title introduces the geometric image as a study of visual movement.
The caption labels the study; the overlapping discs form one abstract image rather than separate story moments.
